ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to all students in the Gies College of Business on Monday, April 15, 2019 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering, General Engineering and Systems Engineering & Design students on Monday, April 22, 2019 at approximately 10:00 a.m. BUSINESS MINOR/PROSPECTIVE BUSINESS MINOR STUDENTS: This section will not open to you since all students are required to take the online option, if offered, as stated on the Business Minor website. BADM 375 is offered online in the summer and winter terms. No exceptions will be made. There are currently 5 seats reserved for Gies College of Business international exchange students only (any exchange students outside of GCOB who try to register will be removed); any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, August 30, 2019 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Marketing or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management or Systems Engineering and Design or Accountancy or Finance or General Engineering or Industrial Engineering or Information Systems or Operations Management major(s) or minor(s).
